originalRequest: 영상 중간보다는, 썸네일을 기준으로 검색하는게 더 잘 찾아진다고 생각하는데. 재생전에 썸네일 기준 검색도 가능하게 해줘. 아니면 아예 썸네일을 기본값으로 잡던가.
supersedes: The previous preplay batch intentionally did not add thumbnail search without authorization. The latest explicit request now authorizes and prefers it. Its no-silent-substitution and current-frame safety requirements remain unchanged.
implemented: Video context menus place 썸네일로 검색 (기본) before the separate 현재 장면으로 검색 option, both using Google Lens. The default choice needs no video metadata, decoded frame or playback.

Freeze the selected video's exact observed official poster URL. Explicit video-thumbnail images before video hydration are supported. Preserve quote/selected-root ownership, one-shot native handoff and stale target rejection.

Resolve only the exact allowlisted public pbs.twimg.com poster via a new credential-free client, with redirects disabled and finite timeout, response size and image pixel limits. Send metadata-free resized JPEG pixels to Lens, not the poster URL or X credentials.

Keep provider consent and account/pane/generation cancellation. The same frozen thumbnail is displayed in consent, search and results. Missing, changed or invalid thumbnails fail explicitly without switching to a video frame or neighbouring image.

Retain existing image-to-SauceNAO, explicit current-frame-to-Lens, download, selection and external-opening behavior. No account operation, user-media transfer, forced app termination or publishing performed.
